certification_reason: Material change to routing, deliberation shape, independence claims, and authority boundaries.

required_invariants: Explicit council requests activate the skill.
Ordinary analysis does not activate solely because it concerns strategy, architecture, or risk.
Single-model role simulation is disclosed and is not labeled multi-model evidence.
Independent participants do not receive another participant's conclusion before their first response.
Evidence, inference, and participant opinion remain distinguishable.
Agreement is allowed; dissent is not manufactured.
The verdict states uncertainty, a bounded next action, and any remaining authorization.
Sensitive context is minimized for every additional participant.

security_gate.policy: Run pinned scanners in an isolated environment; scanners inform admission but never grant authority.
security_gate.acceptance: No unwaived high or critical finding; every waiver binds finding fingerprint, artifact hash, reviewer, reason, and expiry.

requirements: Routing precision and recall meet thresholds across repeated runs.
Every behavioral invariant passes with retained traces.
The skill shows measurable value over the no-skill baseline.
Security findings are resolved or explicitly time-bounded and reviewed.
The certified identity binds skill hash, model, harness, memory/context policy, tools, and runtime.

recertification_triggers: Skill instructions or description change materially.
Model, harness, context policy, tool set, OpenClaw runtime, or security scanner baseline changes materially.
A new high-severity security finding or routing regression appears.
